# Licence of the demo assets

Everything in this folder is dedicated to the public domain under **CC0 1.0 Universal**
(https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Copy it into other projects, including commercial ones, without
attribution.

What it is made from, all CC0 or this repository's own work:

- The character's body, face and expression targets: NAVER Anny's MakeHuman/MPFB2 assets and the Face Units asset
  pack by Mika Suominen, both CC0 1.0 (via https://github.com/naver/anny, checked 2026-11-19).
- The hair: MakeHuman system assets and "Hair 01" hair, CC0 1.0 (https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/index.html,
  checked 2026-11-20), refitted by `tooling/bake/hair`.
- The outfit, eyes, styles and the idle and wave clips: made in this repository.
- The person is synthetic: rendered by `tooling/synth` from Anny with known parameters. No real person's photo or
  likeness is used.

The engine's code is MIT (see the repository's `LICENSE`); these assets are CC0 so they can be dropped into
documentation as they are.
